title: C/M Shri Parmeshwar Deen Mishra Inter College v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashwani Kumar Mishra and Ashutosh Srivastava, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed as withdrawn to pursue Clause 6.5.
headnote: Writ petition dismissed as withdrawn on the petitioners' prayer to pursue the remedy under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. No adjudication of any supply dispute.
facts: The Committee of Management of Shri Parmeshwar Deen Mishra Inter College, with two others, petitioned the Allahabad High Court in Writ-C No. 20018 of 2023 against the State of Uttar Pradesh and four others. After some arguments, counsel for the petitioners asked to withdraw the writ, stating that the petitioners intended to pursue the remedy under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 12 June 2023 the Division Bench dismissed the petition as withdrawn. The order states no facts of any bill, assessment, or supply dispute.

holding_units.holding: On counsel's prayer that the petitioners intended to pursue the remedy under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the writ petition was dismissed as withdrawn. The Court made no finding on any electricity bill or supply dispute.

principle_tags.application: The petitioners withdrew the writ in order to pursue the Clause 6.5 remedy, and the Court dismissed the petition as withdrawn without deciding the supply dispute.

not_decided.point: Merits of any electricity bill, assessment, or supply dispute
not_decided.note: Left untouched because the writ was dismissed as withdrawn before any merits hearing.
